title: teucrium polium var. atlanticum
intro:
Teucrium polium var. atlanticum, commonly known as the Atlantic Gagea, is a variant of the Teucrium polium plant species, which is a type of shrubby perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae).

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium polium var. atlanticum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in reducing pain and swelling, as well as its antioxidant properties, which can protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also being studied for their potential effects on various health conditions.
